format: Transparent SVG, dark and light variants
process: Built-in image_gen explored a minimal logo-and-screens banner. The final artwork is authored as SVG using the existing exact brand vectors and clean device outlines, avoiding generated transparency artifacts. No raster background or embedded image is present.
conceptPrompt:
Create a clean, professional, flat typographic README banner on a truly transparent canvas, 3:1 landscape. This is a fresh redraw, not a photograph or textured image.
Exact wording:
watch.local
Any stream on any screen
Use a disciplined Swiss editorial layout with abundant empty transparent space, the brand name in bold dark graphite #1f2328 and the tagline below in smaller medium gray #59636e. On the far left place the reference's rounded WL monogram, recolored to the same dark graphite, preserving its small cyan dot. DO NOT include the reference's rounded-square app icon background. The monogram should be modest in size, not much taller than the two lines of text together. Keep the name and tagline aligned with each other.
On the right, one compact, flat, monoline illustration of three screens: a slim monitor with a simple stand, a tablet, and a phone. Fine graphite outlines, subtly rounded corners, no gradients, plain transparent screen interiors, a small solid cyan play triangle in each screen. The device group should occupy about 28% of the canvas width. Arrange logo, two-line text, device group with generous even gaps and balanced vertical alignment. Plenty of clear margin outside every object.
This design is for GitHub light mode. Pure flat solid fills and sharp mathematically clean edges. Professional understated software branding, like an excellent open-source developer-tool identity.
TRANSPARENCY: all empty space including the canvas and spaces between letters must be truly alpha transparent. No white or black background, no residual background pixels, no halo, no noise, no distressed edges, no texture, no drop shadows, no blur, no photography, no glass, no fake 3D, no glow, no decorative ribbon, no checkerboard. All visible pixels must belong to crisp logo, typography, cyan accents or the precise device outlines.
flowGraphic: stream-flow.svg remains the hand-authored Resolve → Verify → Play graphic.
